archimate:Capability.documentation: Description: The ability to map out the information requirement (demand for information) and translate it into social tasks that we want to respond to (supply) Explanation: We often do this through strategic relationships, see the social tasks mentioned in the MJP and the process preceding it. Source: B&I architecture, GSBPM, CIO office
